topic: Heat map server backend development needed
summary_markdown:
The heat map feature requires a dedicated server-side component interacting with ClickHouse (CH). Currently, the UI calls a method that is just a placeholder/stub. When testing on the staging analytics dashboard (specifically using the Brazil location data), selecting state levels and districts triggers a request to this empty backend method.

This backend needs to be updated to return multiple metrics for the selected areas, as it currently only returns facility count. Additionally, clarification is needed regarding the date range: whether the client should provide a specific date or if the system should default to a monthly result.
decisions: The heat map feature requires developing a server-side component connected to CH.
action_items: Update the placeholder backend method for the heat map dashboard to return multiple metrics (beyond just facility count) based on selected state/district areas.
Determine and implement logic for handling date range input for the heat map, clarifying if a specific client-provided date or a default monthly period should be used.
